gloss: year by year; with each passing year

definitions.gloss: year by year; with each passing year
definitions.explanation: Indicates a gradual change or progression that occurs as the years pass. Emphasizes cumulative or incremental change over time.

examples.japanese: {気温|きおん}は{年|とし}ごとに{上|あ}がっている。
examples.english: Temperatures are rising year by year.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{年|とし}ごとに{上手|じょうず}になっている。
examples.english: Your Japanese is getting better with each passing year.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}の{人口|じんこう}は{年|とし}ごとに{減|へ}り{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The population of this town continues to decline year after year.

notes:
USAGE:
Follows the pattern ～ごとに (every ~), applied to {年|とし} (year). Used when describing trends, gradual changes, or recurring yearly events. Common in news reporting, statistics, and personal reflection.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {年々|ねんねん}: year after year — more literary/formal, often used in written contexts
- {毎年|まいとし}: every year — focuses on annual recurrence rather than gradual change
- {日|ひ}ごとに: day by day — same pattern but with a shorter time scale
